title: Funding-conditioned correction hazard under volatility regimes — scaled EXPLORATORY_ONLY partial replication of Shek (SSRN 7529458)
frozen_by: agentic work session (sole durable handoff AGENT_HANDOFF.md)
independent_of: FCLR-H002-PARTIAL-REPLICA-v1 (88 events, 5 Binance symbols, 2024-01..2024-03). This scaled study EXCLUDES 2024-01..2024-03 so Arm A is an independent, never-previously-reported sample.
disclaimer: Correction time is a separate outcome from volatility-forecast skill and from observed-liquidation prediction. This study never relabels any result as forecast skill, boundary-breach prediction, or observed-liquidation prediction. Full Shek methodology (SSRN 7529458) is not independently reconstructible (HTTP 403), so this remains a PARTIAL, non-promotable replication.

event_definition_frozen.venue_arm_a: Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual funding rates, 8h cadence (calc_time epoch ms, last_funding_rate)
event_definition_frozen.dedupe: after an extreme on a side, subsequent same-side observations are skipped until funding crosses back inside [p_low, p_high]; keep the FIRST extreme of each same-side cluster
event_definition_frozen.correction: first subsequent funding observation (strictly after the event) back inside the band (positive: funding <= p_high; negative: funding >= p_low)
event_definition_frozen.censored_if: no correction within 168h, or series ends first
event_definition_frozen.rv_regime: trailing 24h realized volatility of mark-price log returns ending at event
event_definition_frozen.rv_split_arm_a: per-symbol RV terciles over events with valid RV: low = rv <= 33.33rd nearest-rank edge; high = rv >= 66.67rd nearest-rank edge; middle otherwise; missing = no valid RV

funding_obs_per_symbol_month.note: every symbol-month has >=84 valid obs (>=30 threshold satisfied at event level)

mark_price_coverage.note: 24h trailing RV requires 23 hourly returns; >=672 rows/month is ample

arm_a_binance_independent.inclusion_rule: event included iff >=30 valid funding obs in the trailing 90d window AND a valid trailing-24h mark-price RV (else rv_regime='missing', still counted in event totals but excluded from the RV-regime contrast)

arm_b_ironflow_crosscoin.rv_split_arm_b: pooled cross-coin RV terciles over all events with valid RV (shared edges, not per-coin)
arm_b_ironflow_crosscoin.note: separate, never-promotable secondary family; results reported but never used to promote H2

inference_method_frozen.km: Kaplan-Meier median correction time per RV regime; if the KM median is not reached (survival stays above 0.5 within the 168h censor), the KM median is reported as '>censor' and the regime is flagged km_median_not_reached. The headline direction is the KM median; the mean corrected time is reported as a secondary tail summary only.
inference_method_frozen.log_rank: two-sided log-rank test (1 df) on high-RV vs low-RV, respecting right-censoring
inference_method_frozen.median_diff_ci: per-coin cluster + per-month block bootstrap 95% CI of the median difference (high-RV median minus low-RV median)
inference_method_frozen.multiplicity: Holm across the pre-specified primary family: pooled high-vs-low, positive-side high-vs-low, negative-side high-vs-low, and per-symbol high-vs-low (5 comparisons). Arm B is a separate secondary family, never merged into the primary Holm family.

sensitivity_grid.usage: reported only; never used to select the headline; headline is the frozen [5,95] / 168h / tercile cell

headline_cell.primary_estimand: high-RV vs low-RV correction-time hazard (direction and Holm-adjusted significance)

verdict_rules.materiality: The pre-registered direction is assessed on the KM/median correction-time contrast, NOT the log-rank p alone. Because the 8h funding cadence quantises correction times to multiples of 8h, a tiny median difference can be log-rank-significant without being economically material. REPLICATES_DIRECTION requires BOTH the direction (high-RV median > low-RV median) AND materiality: |median_diff| >= 0.5 * min(median_high, median_low). A significant log-rank with a sub-material median gap is reported as TAIL_SHAPE_EFFECT, not REPLICATES_DIRECTION.
verdict_rules.REPLICATES_DIRECTION: high-RV KM median > low-RV KM median (lower hazard at higher RV) AND |median_diff| >= 0.5*min(median_high, median_low) AND Holm-adjusted pooled p < 0.05
verdict_rules.TAIL_SHAPE_EFFECT: log-rank (and/or mean tail) differs significantly with the correct direction, but the median contrast is sub-material (|median_diff| < 0.5*min medians); reported as a distributional/tail difference, not a median replication
verdict_rules.NULL: Holm-adjusted pooled p >= 0.05 with a precisely-estimated near-zero difference
verdict_rules.UNDERPOWERED: CI wide enough to include both material improvement and material worsening (median-diff 95% CI crosses both signs at a magnitude > 0.5x pooled median)
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: direction or CI indeterminate, or insufficient events per regime after exclusions
verdict_rules.never_promote: No verdict in this study promotes H2 out of EXPLORATORY_ONLY or into any forecast/liquidation claim

stopping_rules.no_early_peek: This prereg is frozen BEFORE inspecting any correction-time outcome for the scaled sample.
stopping_rules.no_threshold_tuning: Event thresholds, censoring, RV split, and inclusion rules are frozen above; the sensitivity grid is reported, not optimised.
stopping_rules.no_new_data: No network, no paid/credentialed/manual data; cache only.
stopping_rules.stop_condition: Complete the frozen primary cell + full sensitivity grid and record a verdict; do not stop for lack of a trigger.
